run_titles_lang: run the preprocess script with titles_lang action to generate title-to-language pairs from Wikipedia anchors
run_lang_titles: run the preprocess script with lang_titles action to generate language-to-title pairs from Wikipedia anchors
run_canonical_title: run the preprocess script with canonical_title action to generate canonical language and title pairs
run_marginal: run the preprocess script with marginal action to generate all language-title pairs for each entity
run_abstracts_only: run the preprocess script with the abstracts flag to process only abstract paragraphs from Wikipedia
